results.note: Live in all three modes (-c, script file, stdin) with identical psh output. Controls: IFS=: gives <a><b><c> in both; IFS=x with "a b" c gives <a b><c> in both -- confirms the report's claim that they agree only when IFS[0] is a split char. Decision point unchanged: word_expander.py _field_expansion_fields (line ~888) returns None for $*/${a[*]} ('scalar semantics (everything else, including $*/${a[*]})'), so the unquoted form is joined then re-split. bash 5.3.15 behaves exactly as bash_expected.
